Height side: Wood 2014 GWAS = Lango Allen 2010 stage 1 GWA studies + Wood 2014 Supplementary Table 17 (both read in full) + further studies the Wood supplement names but does not tabulate (see notes). BMI side: which Locke 2015 subset was used (European GWAS only, ~234k, or GWAS+Metabochip 322k) is not stated in the abstract, so only Locke European GWAS studies (present in either subset) are listed; Locke Metabochip-only cohorts (e.g. IMPROVE, EPIC-Norfolk T2D, HUNT 2, GLACIER) are unknown. MIGEN is a consortium-level entry in both GIANT inputs.

(2010)', and the Online Methods say the 79 studies are those 'previously described' plus Supplementary Tables 17-19. The same Supplementary Note also reports LMM analyses with WGHS and acknowledges further Lango Allen stage 2 studies (e.g. YFS, Sorbs, HBCS, GOOD, MGS, COROGENE, FINGESTURE) that are in neither Lango Allen stage 1 nor Wood ST17, so the 79-study height list is not fully enumerated by the tables read; listed here are only Lango Allen stage 1 and Wood ST17 studies plus Locke European GWAS studies.
